items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Bebe Ridley worked there sometime, yeah.

ctx.x: Huh? Didn't they have a place called the Tik Tok? I don't know.

That may have been later. I wouldn't say that might have been later. Well, what were some of the bands that were there? Did Bebe Ridley ever work at the Pelican? Anybody know? Bebe Ridley worked there sometime, yeah.
He worked there with the tuxedo band.
